title: Vague bug: is it ready for development?
tests: Gap detection. The ticket lacks almost everything a developer needs. The model must say it is not ready, list what is missing, notice the two different symptoms, and not adopt the reporter's guess as the cause or invent details.
request: Is this ticket ready for a developer to pick up? If not, what is missing?

description: Some users can't log in. It happens sometimes, not always.
Please fix ASAP, customers are complaining!!

comments.author: Marcus Reid
body: Had two calls about this today. One customer said they got "invalid username or password" even though they're sure the password was right. The other said the login page just reloads and nothing happens.

comments.author: Jordan Lee
body: Could it be the password reset changes from last sprint?

answer_key.expect: The ticket is not ready for a developer to pick up.
There are no steps to reproduce.
Environment details are missing: no version, platform, browser or device is given.
There are no timestamps, affected usernames or accounts, logs or exact error details to investigate with.
The ticket is unassigned and has no component.
The two reports describe different symptoms (an 'invalid username or password' error versus the login page silently reloading), so this may be two separate problems.
The reporter's urgency ('fix ASAP, customers are complaining') does not match the Medium priority; priority needs confirming once impact is known.
Next step: go back to the reporter and support (Marcus Reid) for times, affected accounts, browser or device, and exact messages, then check authentication logs for those times.
States that last sprint's password reset changes caused the problem, rather than treating Jordan Lee's question as an unverified hypothesis.
answer_key.claim: The login failures are caused by the password reset changes made last sprint.

answer_key.expect: States a specific version, browser, platform, error code or affected-user count that the ticket does not give.
answer_key.claim: The problem affects version 3.1.4 on Chrome and has hit around 50 users.
